title: Constructing a relation from memory agreement
statement: Let $W$ be a word size, let $Z$ specify a layout with $F$ local variables, dispatcher position $D=Z.\mathrm{disp}$, and space limit, and let $\sigma,\sigma'$ be states with frame pointers $q,q'$. Suppose $m$ satisfies the storage relation for $Z,\sigma,q$, and $m'$ agrees with $m$ outside a set $s$ of addresses disjoint from the addresses of the encoded constants $1,0,-1$ and pool addresses indexed by $n\le D$. Suppose also that $m'$ stores the stack address for frame pointer $q'$ at the frame-pointer address, stores $\sigma'_{\mathrm{loc}}(x)$ at stack address $q'+x$ for every $x<F$, and stores $\sigma'_{\mathrm{mem}}(a)$ at address $a$ for every $a<Z.\mathrm{lim}.\mathrm{space}$. Then $m'$ satisfies the storage relation for $Z,\sigma',q'$.
hypotheses_covered: The set $s$ is disjoint from the encoded constant and pool addresses through $Z.\mathrm{disp}$
